findings.reason: the node would re-anchor only the `from_state`, still see the cadence ids red, and either rediscover the cause the hard way or widen an exemption the plan deliberately keeps narrow; the plan needs the real recipe (arm the cadence follower with its own session, or re-anchor to coordinator-kind transitions with the clock advanced past SETTLE_WINDOW).
findings.text: §15 says the cadence ids' transition lines "carry no `from_state`, so no exemption reaches them, and those fixtures are re-anchored to carry the `from_state` of the transition each case exercises", but every exemption the plan adds keys on a session the pane owns or observes — the observed-session exemption on the threaded observed set, the own-session start and own-session baseline exemptions on `self._own_session` — and the cadence pane names no session: `_Follower.start` calls `cli._follow_watch_lines(self.project, ...)` with no `session=`, so `own_session` is None (`reckon/crew_follow_commands.py:1158`) and adding a `from_state` to a `(None, "working")` line yields `("starting", "working")`, still observer context and still withheld; so the stated remedy does not produce the done-when's "thirteen ids pass alone" for the cadence cases, and the stated reason (a missing `from_state`) misidentifies the mechanism, which is that the pane owns no session
